script_text: Stop! Mars is squaring your Libra scales, igniting restless tension in relationships. Venus in harmonious trine with Neptune invites dreamy, yet fleeting connections—guard your heart from illusion. Mercury retrograde in Gemini stirs miscommunications; pause before replying, especially in contracts. The Moon's waxing phase amplifies your intuition; trust gut feelings when choosing projects. Saturn's steady influence steadies your finances, but avoid impulsive spending on luxury. Uranus surprises with a flash of insight—embrace change in your creative routine. As the Sun moves into Aquarius, your social circle expands; network wisely, but keep boundaries clear. This week, balance ambition with self‑care: meditate at dusk, stretch, and sip herbal tea. Remember, Libra, your scales seek equilibrium—listen to inner whispers, and let the cosmos guide you toward harmony. Jupiter's hopeful glow in Sagittarius lifts your spirit, urging you to explore fresh ideas and creative projects.
